### Reading rules
- **Never compare across tiers as if equal.** Tier-3 is 8/255 (harsher on linf) so those numbers read >= ours at 0.03. Tier-2 vs Tier-1 differ by recipe/source (F7: MAX 19pp, AVG 1.9pp).
- Claim ladder: C1 mechanism (F4-F6) + F7 eval corrections + C2 = a simple cheap adaptive weighting reaching the 43.9-44.6 cluster, **not exceeding it**.
- All numbers here are APGD (CE+T) unless a `std` column says otherwise; finalists get full `standard` AA before any claim (see results/standard_vs_apgd.md).
